body:
Shipped and installed BUG-89 in aida-host (PR #14, commit 3e99cd8):
1. ~/.local/bin/sccache (bin/sccache) and ~/.local/bin/cargo (bin/cargo) now detect contained seats (AIDA_CONTAINED=1, unwritable SCCACHE_DIR, or denied sccache socket/cache exit 2) and automatically degrade to direct rustc (export RUSTC_WRAPPER="" CARGO_BUILD_RUSTC_WRAPPER="") with a one-line stderr notice, including on passthrough subcommands like 'cargo metadata'.
2. When /run/user/1000/aida-cargo is read-only inside the container, 'bin/cargo' shares the host's pre-created queue.lock and slot-0..3.lock via flock (ADR-88 / BUG-87), and if lock files are absent or denied, degrades to no-slot with a one-line notice.
3. 'cargo ps' and 'cargo log' now resolve generic scratch clone basenames ('x', 'tmp', 'work', 'repo', 'clone') to the branch basename (e.g. 'story-1674' from 'codex/story-1674') or 'job:<id>' (from '/.claude/jobs/<id>/'), and include the extracted spec / AIDA_AGENT_NAME in WHO and OWNER.

Action for advisor launch prompts: you can now drop 'RUSTC_WRAPPER= AIDA_CARGO_NO_SLOT=1' from contained-seat launch prompts so contained jobs participate in the 2-slot limiter instead of bypassing slots as NOSLOT.
subject: BUG-89 shipped & installed (PR #14, 3e99cd8) — contained seats no longer need AIDA_CARGO_NO_SLOT=1 or RUSTC_WRAPPER=
